product.name: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Platform
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing patient clinical data, customizable for over 20 medical specialties, accessible via web and mobile devices.

product.name: Practice Management Software
product.description: Software for managing administrative tasks including appointment scheduling, patient check-in, reminders, and payment processing.

product.name: Medical Billing Software
product.description: Integrated billing software that automates claims submission, manages billing profiles, and provides reporting and denial resolution tools.

product.name: Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Services
product.description: Outsourced medical billing and coding services to improve claim approval rates and manage revenue collection.

product.name: Telehealth Platform
product.description: A feature enabling scheduling and conducting video visits directly from the EHR on desktop or mobile devices.

product.name: Mobile EHR Application
product.description: Mobile applications for iPhone, iPad, and Mac that provide access to the EHR system for clinical documentation and practice management on the go.
